cells.gaps: No source counts the centres entering births on the DHIS2 platform: the two newest office facts (LBR-012, LBR-015; 15 counties, 58 centres) publish no number, and the only count is 14 centres in 2015 with no total (LBR-032), which does not say the centres make the digital entry. LBR-017 (May 2024) says County Service Center services remain mostly paper, against LBR-010's county teams registering online; the 2024 policy (LBR-006) gives no period and is not said to name the platform; nothing is dated inside the twelve months, the last event being 2024 (LBR-013).
cells.note: County birth registration teams register births online on the DHIS2 platform, past any pilot, so stage 3 is met. Stage 4 needs more than half of local offices on a share or a count with a denominator, and none is published.
